title: Global Menu widget shows and focuses on a useless popup when activated via keyboard
line: In single-button mode, the Global Menu shortcut now opens the app's menu instead of an empty "Global Menu" popup.
explanation: In single-button mode the widget used a compact representation, so activating it from its shortcut or panel keyboard navigation made libplasma expand the full representation in a popup. That popup held only the "Global Menu" placeholder button and took keyboard focus, and the handler that opens the app's menu lived inside it. The widget now always uses the inline representation, shows the single button there in single-button mode, and opens the app's menu when activated.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: Open the menu when activating the single-button mode

In single-button mode the shortcut and panel keyboard navigation expanded
an empty "Global Menu" popup that took focus, so show the single button in
the inline representation instead and open the app's menu on activation.

BUG: 379242

patches.diff:
From 59c0cd0b835996eee57a5137f529ceca6d6e48fd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:12:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/appmenu: Open the menu when activating the
 single-button mode

In single-button mode the shortcut and panel keyboard navigation expanded
an empty "Global Menu" popup that took focus, so show the single button in
the inline representation instead and open the app's menu on activation.

BUG: 379242
---
 applets/appmenu/qml/main.qml | 59 +++++++++++++++++++++---------------
 1 file changed, 35 insertions(+), 24 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/appmenu/qml/main.qml b/applets/appmenu/qml/main.qml
index e9f5280a3f..98f0e09c03 100644
--- a/applets/appmenu/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/appmenu/qml/main.qml
@@ -30,28 +30,9 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     }
 
     Plasmoid.constraintHints: Plasmoid.CanFillArea
-    preferredRepresentation: Plasmoid.configuration.compactView ? compactRepresentation : fullRepresentation
-
-    // Only exists because the default CompactRepresentation doesn't expose a
-    // way to mark its icon as disabled.
-    // TODO remove once it gains that feature.
-    compactRepresentation: PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
-        readonly property int fakeIndex: 0
-        Layout.fillWidth: false
-        Layout.fillHeight: false
-        Layout.minimumWidth: implicitWidth
-        Layout.maximumWidth: implicitWidth
-        enabled: appMenuModel.menuAvailable
-        checkable: appMenuModel.menuAvailable && Plasmoid.currentIndex === fakeIndex
-        checked: checkable
-        icon.name: "application-menu"
-
-        display: PlasmaComponents3.AbstractButton.IconOnly
-        text: Plasmoid.title
-        Accessible.description: root.toolTipSubText
-
-        onClicked: Plasmoid.trigger(this, 0);
-    }
+    // Also in single-button mode, whose popup is the app's menu: a compact representation would open an
+    // empty popup when the widget is activated from the keyboard.
+    preferredRepresentation: fullRepresentation
 
     fullRepresentation: GridLayout {
         id: buttonGrid
@@ -92,6 +73,10 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         Connections {
             target: Plasmoid
             function onActivated() {
+                if (Plasmoid.configuration.compactView) {
+                    Plasmoid.trigger(compactButton, 0);
+                    return;
+                }
                 const button = buttonRepeater.itemAt(0) as MenuDelegate;
                 if (button) {
                     button.activated();
@@ -99,9 +84,34 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             }
         }
 
+        // single-button mode
+        PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.compactView
+            implicitWidth: compactButton.implicitWidth
+            implicitHeight: compactButton.implicitHeight
+            mainText: Plasmoid.title
+            subText: root.toolTipSubText
+
+            PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
+                id: compactButton
+                readonly property int fakeIndex: 0
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                enabled: appMenuModel.menuAvailable
+                checkable: appMenuModel.menuAvailable && Plasmoid.currentIndex === fakeIndex
+                checked: checkable
+                icon.name: "application-menu"
+
+                display: PlasmaComponents3.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                text: Plasmoid.title
+                Accessible.description: root.toolTipSubText
+
+                onClicked: Plasmoid.trigger(this, 0);
+            }
+        }
+
         PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
             id: noMenuPlaceholder
-            visible: buttonRepeater.count === 0
+            visible: !Plasmoid.configuration.compactView && buttonRepeater.count === 0
             text: Plasmoid.title
             Layout.fillWidth: root.vertical
             Layout.fillHeight: !root.vertical
@@ -109,7 +119,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         Repeater {
             id: buttonRepeater
-            model: appMenuModel.visible ? appMenuModel : null
+            model: appMenuModel.visible && !Plasmoid.configuration.compactView ? appMenuModel : null
 
             MenuDelegate {
                 required property int index
@@ -136,6 +146,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             }
         }
         Item {
+            visible: !Plasmoid.configuration.compactView
             Layout.preferredWidth: 0
             Layout.preferredHeight: 0
             Layout.fillWidth: true
--

media.caption: Single-button mode, Dolphin focused, Meta+Alt+G: an empty "Global Menu" popup
Same shortcut: Dolphin's menu opens from the button
Down, Down: nothing happens, focus is in the useless popup
Down, Down: the keyboard moves through the menu
Shortcut, arrow keys, then a mouse click (only the click opens the menu)
Same steps: shortcut and click both open the menu

review.text: Correct cause: libplasma always expands a compact representation on activation, so the empty popup can only be avoided by not using one; moving the single button into the inline representation and triggering the menu from onActivated is the least intrusive way. The old compactRepresentation was only a workaround anyway, and the tooltip, disabled state and full mode are kept. The after screenshot shows the app's menu opened from the button.
